attempts.summary: Configured a DHCP relay path so node3 obtains its address from node2's DHCP service across node1's two separate L2 segments (eth1 to node2's 172.20.1.0/24, eth2 to node3's 172.20.2.0/24). Installed and configured Kea DHCPv4 on node2 serving subnet 172.20.2.0/24 via relay, installed isc-dhcp-relay (dhcrelay) on node1 to bridge broadcasts between the segments, fixed a broken openssl-libs dependency, opened firewalld's dhcp service on node2, and added the missing return route on node2 for the relay's giaddr. Verified node3 obtains a real DHCP lease (172.20.2.124/24, gateway 172.20.2.1) from node2 through node1's relay. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-ID proof of restart and post-restart recovery verification, including a final live DHCP renewal on node3 after all three reboots.
